answer: Dawn-Vertex Grove: each epoch a beacon assigns every identity a vertex in a task grove; within a 5–20s window the agent must complete a context-bound microtask and chain the result to its prior vertex. Missing two dawn epochs drops routing priority. Sybils must split sustained attention across all identities; beyond small fan-out, latency and context-switch misses exceed rewards, so each extra identity consumes real operator attention, not just capital.
